How We Work

Straightforward, start to finish.

A free first conversation, a written estimate, a deliverable at the end, and an honest answer about whether we're the right people at all.

Pricing & Engagement→ Access & Discounts→

What stays the same on every engagement

Human-first

Technology magnifies what people are already doing. It is not the point. We put real effort into understanding how your organization actually works before we propose anything.

Before we propose

Something concrete, every time

Every engagement ends with a deliverable, so when it is over you know exactly what you got.

Every engagement

Shaped to fit

We start with a free, no-pressure conversation, as formal or informal as you like. Some engagements need a proper scoping exercise and others just need a scope of work. We do not run every client through the same machine.

No standard process

Honest about fit

If we are not the right people for the job, we will say so, and we will try to point you toward someone who is.

Including no

Why us

You're the destination, not a stepping stone

We are not building a portfolio on small clients so we can go chase bigger ones. This is the work we want.

We know how to make a dollar scream

Our team has worked in some of the lowest-resource settings in the world and with bootstrapped nonprofits running on fumes. Doing more with less is not a slogan here, it is where we learned the job.

We fight for you with vendors who ignore you

Small organizations get pushed around by their software companies. We know how to make a forceful, well-documented case on your behalf. That is leverage you do not have alone.

We hand you the keys

We document what we do and build your team's ability to run it without us. That means you could take our documentation and hire someone cheaper next time. Most consultants have every reason not to work that way. We think it is the only honest way to work.

The first conversation

It's free, it commits you to nothing, and it's as formal or informal as you want it to be. Tell us what you're dealing with and we'll tell you what it would take.

Maine technology consulting for small businesses, nonprofits, startups, and public agencies.
